high_level_description: This image captures an astronaut inside the Cupola module of the International Space Station (ISS). The Cupola is a cylindrical module with six large windows that provide a panoramic view of Earth from space. Setting: The setting is the interior of the ISS's Cupola module. The Cupola is a unique feature of the ISS, designed to provide astronauts with a 360-degree view of Earth and space. The windows of the Cupola show a stunning view of Earth below, with clouds and landmasses visible through the glass. People:
